in_marathi.name: Dhirendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fearless, Valiant, Brave
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhirendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhirendar is a compound Sanskrit name composed of two parts: Dhi and Indra. Dhi means 'intelligence' or 'thought'. Indra signifies 'god of rain' or 'leader'. Thus, Dhirendar can be interpreted as 'fearless leader', 'intelligent ruler', or 'brave hero'. In Hindu mythology, Indra is known for his fearlessness and strength, making Dhirendar an inspiring name for a son.
